_meta.purpose: Self-contained record of ALL effective LM Studio settings for thesis generation runs. LM Studio's own per-model JSON stores only overrides; this file consolidates overrides + defaults.

sources.ui_default: value read from LM Studio Load/Inference panels on 2026-09-07; not stored by LM Studio because it equals the app or GGUF-metadata default

resolved: pipeline.request_overrides: RESOLVED 2026-09-07 by wire capture of the real request body (not inferred from source).

model.role: THE REPORTED GENERATOR. q8_k_xl is the arm every Stage 2 number in the thesis comes from: 12 conditions x 45 questions = 540 generations. (q4_k_xl, a separate file/quant, is development history and the validator regression baseline -- not reported.) Not an A/B arm: the thesis reports one generator and makes no quantization comparison.

runtime.gguf_runtime: Metal llama.cpp v2.33.0 (LM Studio runtime extension pack)
runtime.hardware: Mac Studio, M3 Ultra, 512 GB unified memory

load._kv_note: q8_0 KV is what the REPORTED 12-condition grid actually ran, and it stays that way -- the 27B is NOT being re-run. Flash-Next runs f16 KV because quantized KV is unsupported for qwen4exp on this runtime (see that file's _kv_note), so the two arms differ in KV cache precision. That difference is a DISCLOSED CONFOUND of the robustness check, not something being equalized: it is one more axis on which the two generators differ, alongside architecture, parameter count and attention design, and no result is attributed to any single one of them.

request_overrides._measured: Captured 2026-09-07 from the actual /v1/chat/completions request body via an httpx event hook on the client run_generation._call_local_seeded uses. These are the wire values, not a reading of the source.
request_overrides.reasoning_effort: none  -- sent as a TOP-LEVEL body key (extra_body flattens on the wire). NOT "off": the LM Studio server rejects "off"; valid values are none/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh. Verified suppressing: usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens == 0 and no reasoning_content on both models.
request_overrides.max_tokens: ABSENT from the request body. This repo sends no token cap at all, so output length is bounded only by this file's inference.max_tokens (null) and the model's own end token. Measured clean: finish_reason == "stop" on all probed items, never "length".
request_overrides._overrides_the_panel: IMPORTANT: the request body's temperature 0 and seed 20260831 OVERRIDE this file's inference.temperature (0.1) and load.seed (67). The panel values are what LM Studio would apply to a request that omitted them; every thesis generation sends both, so 0.1 and 67 are NOT what ran. Sampling is greedy at temperature 0.
request_overrides._not_sent_left_to_this_file: top_k, top_p, min_p, repeat_penalty are never sent by this repo and come entirely from inference.* below. Verified identical across both models on 2026-09-07 (top_k 40, top_p 0.95, min_p 0.05, repeat_penalty 1.1), so they are held constant across arms rather than being an uncontrolled difference. repeat_penalty is the one that still bites at temperature 0, and it matches.

pipeline.note: Thinking is disabled twice: model config enable_thinking=false AND per-request reasoning_effort="none" (measured, see request_overrides).

chat_template.source: Unsloth stock template with local edits
edits: added real 'medium' tier (stock emits no instruction for medium)
chat_template.effect_under_thinking_off: none - all edits are inside the enable_thinking branch or affect multi-turn history only; rendered prompt is byte-identical to the stock template
